ingest.heading: OBS connection

state.waiting: Waiting for OBS or another RTMP publisher

ingest.publisherNote: RTMP does not identify the application, so any RTMP publisher is accepted, not only OBS.

connection.heading: OBS settings
connection.notASecret: This stream key is a local route name, not a secret and not a destination platform key. It is safe to share in a screenshot.
connection.instructions: In OBS open Settings, then Stream, choose Custom, and paste these two values.

controls.heading: Service controls
controls.note: These controls start and stop the local ingest service only. They do not start streaming to any platform.

install.title: Install MediaMTX
install.intro: Streaming Tree needs MediaMTX to receive the stream from OBS. It is not installed yet.
install.versionLine: Version {{version}} will be downloaded from the official MediaMTX release on GitHub.
install.checksumLine: The download is verified against the official SHA-256 checksum published with that release, and is discarded if it does not match.
install.thirdPartyLine: MediaMTX is third-party software under the MIT licence. Its licence file is installed alongside the program and is listed in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
install.sizeLine: The download is roughly 30 MB and may take a few minutes.

errors.notInstalled: MediaMTX is not installed yet. Install it to receive a stream from OBS.
errors.incompatibleVersion: The MediaMTX binary found is not the supported version. Install the supported version, or point STREAMING_TREE_MEDIAMTX_PATH at it.
errors.unsupportedPlatform: There is no official MediaMTX release for this operating system and processor architecture. You can set STREAMING_TREE_MEDIAMTX_PATH to a compatible binary you provide yourself.
errors.checksumMismatch: The downloaded file did not match the official checksum and was discarded. Nothing was installed. Try again, and check for a proxy that modifies downloads.
errors.downloadFailed: MediaMTX could not be downloaded. Check the network connection and try again.
errors.archiveInvalid: The downloaded archive could not be used and was discarded. Nothing was installed.
errors.permissionDenied: MediaMTX could not be installed or started because of a file permission error. Check the permissions on the application data directory.
errors.portInUse: The configured port is already used by another application. Stop that application, or choose a different port.
errors.readinessTimeout: MediaMTX started but did not become ready in time. It was stopped.
errors.restartLimit: MediaMTX failed repeatedly and will not be restarted automatically. Fix the underlying problem, then start it manually.
errors.apiUnreachable: MediaMTX is running but its status could not be read.
errors.invalidState: That action is not possible right now.

page.title: Streams
page.description: Local ingest from OBS, and outgoing destination branches.

ffmpeg.heading: FFmpeg dependency
ffmpeg.notFoundNote: Set STREAMING_TREE_FFMPEG_PATH, or install FFmpeg and make sure it is on PATH. Destinations cannot be started until a compatible FFmpeg is found.
ffmpeg.incompatibleNote: The FFmpeg found is missing a required capability, or is older than the minimum supported version. Destinations cannot be started until a compatible FFmpeg is available.

branch.heading: Destination branches
branch.noDestinations: No destinations are configured yet. Add one from the dashboard.

blockers.credentialStoreUnavailable: The secure credential store is not available
blockers.ffmpegIncompatible: The FFmpeg found is not compatible
blockers.mediamtxNotReady: The local ingest service is not ready
blockers.ingestNotReceiving: No stream is currently being received from OBS

confirmStart.title: Start outgoing streaming?
confirmStart.bandwidthNote: Outgoing bandwidth use increases once per destination started.
confirmStart.streamCopyNote: No video is re-encoded: each destination receives the same encoded stream OBS already sends, copied as-is.
confirmStart.realTransmissionNote: This begins real transmission to each started destination's platform.
confirmStart.noneEligible: No enabled destination is currently eligible to start.

branch.startSingleNote: This begins real outgoing transmission to this destination's platform.
